rows.title: Radisson Blu Bariloche
rows.body:
Resort, Argentina, CALA, Lakeside debut

San Carlos de Bariloche, Río Negro, Argentina (Lake Nahuel Huapi)

New-build · upper-upscale · lake and mountain leisure

CALA debut · Andes leisure compression

Opened September 2025 on the lakeshore—Choice Hotels' Argentina debut for Radisson Blu with Nordic Nouveau public spaces, wellness, and outdoor-adventure positioning in the Andes.

If you are looking at resort leisure in the Andes, plan for strong seasonality and full F&B/wellness investment—opening photos do not replace local occupancy patterns.

https://www.choicehotels.com/argentina/san-carlos-de-bariloche/radisson-blu-hotels/aa022
rows.caseSummaryOverview: Bariloche, Argentina: Radisson Blu on Lake Nahuel Huapi—publicly described as a September 2025 opening and Choice's first Radisson Blu in Argentina, in a Swiss-Alps-style leisure market.
rows.caseSummaryBrandRelevance: Relevant when you are evaluating upper-upscale resort or mixed leisure in CALA—not core Radisson conversion economics.
rows.caseSummaryOwnerObjective: Shows Blu design-forward leisure in a seasonal mountain/lake destination with Choice distribution and Privileges retail.
rows.caseSummaryInterpretation: Lake and mountain seasons swing occupancy—budget F&B and wellness for your market’s peak and shoulder months, not only on opening headlines.
rows.caseSummaryTags: Argentina, CALA, Resort, Lakeside, New opening

rows.title: Radisson Blu Aruba
rows.body:
Resort, Caribbean, CALA, Beachfront leisure

Palm Beach, Aruba

Resort upper-upscale · beach and rooftop pool

Caribbean leisure · Inspired Professional mix

Palm Beach upper-upscale resort with beach access, dining, and adults-only rooftop infinity pool—illustrative Blu leisure compression in the Caribbean CALA corridor.

Resort Blu here is about beach retail and leisure compression—confirm fees, seasonality, and who operates F&B for your parcel, not just brand positioning.

https://www.choicehotels.com/aruba/palm-beach/radisson-blu-hotels/aw007
rows.caseSummaryOverview: Palm Beach, Aruba: Radisson Blu resort-format upper-upscale on the beach strip—leisure and event demand from North American and regional fly-in guests.
rows.caseSummaryBrandRelevance: Reference for resort Blu in CALA/Caribbean versus urban greenfield or conversion plays in Mexico or Brazil.
rows.caseSummaryOwnerObjective: Benchmark for upper-upscale leisure public spaces, F&B theater, and loyalty-led retail in a compressed resort market.
rows.caseSummaryInterpretation: Beach hotels on this strip compete on seasonality and fees—check year-round demand for your site before you assume Palm Beach results from one hotel.

rows.title: Radisson Blu Belo Horizonte, Savassi
rows.body:
Urban, Brazil, CALA, Business and leisure

Belo Horizonte, Minas Gerais, Brazil (Savassi)

Upper-upscale urban · meetings and F&B

Secondary-city gateway · corporate and group

Savassi-district Radisson Blu serving Brazil's third-largest metro—upper-upscale rooms and public spaces for corporate transient, meetings, and weekend leisure in Minas Gerais.

Secondary-city Blu needs meetings and full-service F&B—confirm local demand, fees, and operator capability for your asset before you commit.

https://www.choicehotels.com/minas-gerais/belo-horizonte/radisson-blu-hotels/br154
rows.caseSummaryOverview: Belo Horizonte, Savassi: Radisson Blu in a dense Brazilian secondary city—meetings-capable upper-upscale box under Choice-affiliated distribution.
rows.caseSummaryBrandRelevance: Illustrates Blu in Brazilian urban markets where owners want design heritage plus Choice systems—not mainstream Radisson conversion.
rows.caseSummaryOwnerObjective: Relevant when comparing upper-upscale greenfield or conversion against local independent and soft-brand supply in CALA.
rows.caseSummaryInterpretation: In a secondary city, Blu works when meetings and F&B are real—match Savassi-style demand and operator strength to your building before you sign.

rows.title: Radisson Blu São Paulo
rows.body:
Urban gateway, Brazil, CALA, Corporate transient

São Paulo, Brazil (Cidade Jardim corridor)

Upper-upscale urban flagship · meetings and dining

Top-tier CALA metro · Inspired Professional

São Paulo Radisson Blu for corporate transient, international arrivals, and group demand in Brazil's primary business hub—upper-upscale Nordic Nouveau positioning with Choice Privileges retail.

For a gateway urban asset, your economics depend on corporate/group mix, parking, and nearby international supply—use local comps, not U.S. suburban Blu assumptions.

https://www.choicehotels.com/sao-paulo/sao-paulo/radisson-blu-hotels/br167
rows.caseSummaryOverview: São Paulo: Radisson Blu in a top-tier CALA business capital—gateway corporate and international demand with full-service upper-upscale expectations.
rows.caseSummaryBrandRelevance: Benchmark when owners pitch Blu against international chains in dense São Paulo competitive sets.
rows.caseSummaryOwnerObjective: Shows how Blu pairs design-forward F&B and meetings product with Choice distribution in Latin America's largest metro.
rows.caseSummaryInterpretation: São Paulo gateways live on corporate, group, and international mix—not a U.S. suburban template—build your budget from local contracts, parking, and your comp set.
rows.caseSummaryTags: Brazil, CALA, São Paulo, Urban gateway, Corporate

rows.title: Radisson Blu Plaza El Bosque Santiago
rows.body:
Urban, Chile, CALA, Business district

Santiago, Chile (Las Condes / El Bosque corridor)

Upper-upscale downtown · meetings and group

Chile capital · corporate and international

Las Condes-area Radisson Blu for Santiago corporate transient, meetings, and international arrivals—upper-upscale public spaces and group product in Chile's primary business capital.

Urban Chile hinges on groups, parking, and international competition—confirm meetings capability and fees on your deal before you use industry averages.

https://www.choicehotels.com/chile/santiago/radisson-blu-hotels/cl012
rows.caseSummaryOverview: Santiago, Las Condes: Radisson Blu Plaza El Bosque—upper-upscale urban hotel in Chile's financial and diplomatic corridor.
rows.caseSummaryBrandRelevance: Urban Blu reference in CALA when owners need meetings-capable upper-upscale versus coastal resort economics.
rows.caseSummaryOwnerObjective: Pair with Concón resort example to show Blu urban vs resort delivery under the same Chilean market umbrella.
rows.caseSummaryInterpretation: Downtown Santiago rewards group business and parking—confirm your operator can fill meetings and compete with nearby international flags before you rely on averages.
